wppo-researcher.description: Read-only research orchestrator for the WordPress feature monitor. Returns findings as JSON text; writes no files. Shell is limited to jq/echo for the mandatory final-JSON self-verification before stopping.

wppo-lane-researcher.description: Read-only research lane (Task-invoked). Returns findings as message text; cannot edit, run shell, or spawn subagents.

wppo-issue-publisher.description: Files GitHub issues for pre-validated Tier-A findings via gh CLI. No edits, no web tools, no shell beyond gh issue create/list and sleep.
